title: Copying a segment of the input
statement: Let $e$ be an exactness flag, and let $z,\mathrm{code},x$ be Boolean words with $z=\mathrm{dbl}(\mathrm{code})\mathbin{++}[0,1]\mathbin{++}x$. For every $n,r,h\in\mathbb{N}$ with $h+r\le n$ and $h+r\le |x|$, and every valid bounds witnessing $2|\mathrm{code}|+2+h\le |z|$ and $2|\mathrm{code}|+2+(h+r)\le |z|$, running the machine for $r$ steps from the copy configuration positioned at offset $2|\mathrm{code}|+2+h$, with the value tape holding the first $h$ bits of $x$, yields the copy configuration at offset $2|\mathrm{code}|+2+(h+r)$, with the value tape holding the first $h+r$ bits of $x$.
